During the [[Galactic War]], the corrupted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Warren Sedoru]] '''attacked''' the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Valiant (Valor-class)|''Valiant'']] just off of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and captured its commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dabrin]]. However, the [[Hero of Tython]] boarded the cruiser and managed to defeat Sedoru, rescuing Admiral Dabrin in the process.
